notes.title: Ancient Conspiracy Bundle - not to be missed!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33035039/e3dc1a931103a0683dc3e60fe5ba41cc9640cbf3.jpg[/img]
[b]This is solitaire as you’ve never seen it before: two innovative takes on the classic card game from renowned British indie studios. Not to be missed.[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18706/Ancient_Conspiracy/][h1]Buy this bundle to save 10% on both items! [/h1][/url]

[h1]Ancient Enemy [/h1]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33035039/a61d7020a64a0ac23b3cbb66a5a1d489aac94da5.gif[/img]
An RPG card battler set in a crumbling world where the forces of evil have already won. Blast distorted enemies with a satisfying range of spells and abilities. Journey into a scarred wilderness and draw power and hope from the landscape to defeat the deadliest foe of all! 

Ancient Enemy is an atmospheric turn-based adventure in the spirit of masterpieces such as Darkest Dungeon and Slay The Spire! 

[h1]The Solitaire Conspiracy[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33035039/571f6241312b4d92387d2ca08d2c96b936a370d4.gif[/img]
We need your help, Spymaster. Join a world of near-future spies and take on a supervillain in this supercharged take on classic Solitaire. Precision engineered for replayable espionage action. 

This heightened game of Solitaire stands out for its full FMV cutscenes, featuring Greg Miller and Inel Tomlinson in an original story from the team behind Thomas Was Alone, Volume, Subsurface Circular and John Wick Hex.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18706/Ancient_Conspiracy/]Buy Now![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Ancient Enemy - New Gameplay Video
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33035039/3b431faec6f506ded7bba0f86db725ce1f4259ad.jpg[/img]

We've put together a short video to show you exactly how strategic gameplay works in our forthcoming card battler, Ancient Enemy.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dcglX1KP4XQ
Game features:

- Innovative, strategic, turn-based combat.
- Blast the Enemy's monstrous lieutenants with a satisfying range of spells and abilities.
- Gather powers from the shattered landscape to heal your mind and enhance your magic.
- Choose your own path through a dark, folkloric story.
- Three difficulty settings ranging from relaxed to nightmare.
- Duel your way to the citadel, and defeat your foe once and for all!

Wishlist now!

notes.title: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire - Collector's Edition is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33035039/24030f572c18583a270edd72f94d61d070983c93.jpg[/img]

Take a deep dive into the magical undersea world of Atlantis Solitaire! Voyage across 400 (!) submarine levels

15% off until 14 November

Take a deep dive into the magical undersea world of Atlantis Solitaire! Voyage across 400 (!) submarine levels and restore 10 breathtaking Aquascapes to their former glory.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33035039/d3cebdc096b6ac8fce1030c81fe75f50dbf69156.jpg[/img]

Overcome obstacles like locks, chains, seaweed, and more to collect the bonus gems and coins in each level. Visit the shop to check on the myriad items available for purchase to help you on your quest. Unlock 18 bonus solitaire variants and enjoy playing 100 levels of a fully featured Mahjong game. Explore majestic underwater locations and embark on an epic Solitaire journey through the legendary continent of Atlantis.

Features:
- 400 Solitaire levels.
- 18 additional Solitaire variants like Double Klondike or Freecell Kings!
- 100 replayable bonus mahjong levels!
- 10 beautiful underwater scenes to build.
- Choose between multiple card decks to play with.
- Tons of game play variations and power-ups.
- Play Hard and Relaxed modes.
- Unlock stunning wallpapers for your desktop.
- Enjoy a haunting, ethereal soundtrack. 

Available now on Steam for PC!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1126470/Jewel_Match_Atlantis_Solitaire__Collectors_Edition/
